Traders Flag Concerns Over Opposition Rally's Impact on Diwali Business

Delhi traders have written to Congress leader Rahul Gandhi expressing concerns that the INDIA bloc's rally at Ramlila Maidan could disrupt business ahead of Diwali. The traders warned that approximately 80% of shops might be shut, potentially leading to losses estimated at ₹2,000 crore. This marks the fourth such representation to Rahul Gandhi, with previous appeals also made to Sonia Gandhi. The rally, described as a "riot of colour" and showcasing "diversity on display," is scheduled to take place near the markets.
